subject: Vendor onboarding — support playbook & PO flow (kickoff)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@optiscale.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — support playbook & PO flow (kickoff)

Hi Leah —

Thanks for moving forward with Redwood procurement. We want to kick off vendor setup and get a concise support/SLA and PO checklist so procurement can finish vendor setup in our systems this week. Can you please confirm the items below (feel free to attach a single playbook/pdf):

- Primary support contacts (name, role, email, phone) and the escalation chain (who to call for P1/P2/P3)
- SLA/Uptime targets and remediation (SLA credits, measurement window, and target availability over a 30/90d period)
- Response & resolution targets by severity (P1/P2/P3) and on-call hours (timezone)
- Maintenance windows / planned outage notification process (SLO for advance notice)
- PO and invoicing instructions (billing email, remit-to address, PO acceptance process, required fields)
- Vendor security evidence: SOC 2 attestation, data handling matrix, encryption at rest/in transit statements
- Access for our finance team to any vendor portal or billing console (URL + admin contact)
- Any onboarding forms you need Redwood to complete (vendor setup forms, W-9/EU equivalents)

I've attached our Redwood_Onboarding_Template.xlsx as a starting point — it has our legal & tax details, invoice remit info, and contact placeholders. If you can return a single support playbook/PDF and the PO instructions, procurement will cut the vendor record and confirm the PO flow.

Target: vendor record created + PO process validated by EOD Thursday (2026-04-15).

Appreciate it —

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Template.xlsx (excel spreadsheet, 1 sheet - vendor contact & remit details)

From: Leah Park <leah.park@optiscale.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: billing@optiscale.com
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — support playbook & PO flow (kickoff)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching our support playbook and PO instructions here. Answers inline below and in the attached playbook.

- Primary support contacts:
  - Tier 1 (portal triage): support@optiscale.com (24x7 ticketing)
  - Tier 2 (technical): Aaron Chu, Technical Lead — aaron.chu@optiscale.com, +1 (646) 555-0199 (Mon–Fri 7:00–19:00 PT)
  - Tier 3 (engineering on-call): PagerDuty escalation — see playbook for rotation (PDT-based)

- Escalation chain: Tier 1 -> Tier 2 -> Tier 3 (PagerDuty). For P1s, PagerDuty notify after 15 minutes of no Tier 2 ack.

- SLA / Uptime: 99.95% monthly availability for the inference API endpoints (exceptions for agreed maintenance). SLA credits available as 10% monthly service credit for each 0.1% breach beyond 99.95%, capped at 50% per month (details in playbook).

- Response & resolution targets:
  - P1 (service down): initial response within 1 hour, mitigation plan within 4 hours, full resolution target 24 hours (varies by root cause)
  - P2 (degraded performance): initial response 4 hours, target resolution 72 hours
  - P3 (general questions / feature help): response 2 business days

- On-call hours: Tier 2 coverage Mon–Fri 07:00–19:00 PT; PagerDuty covers P1 outside those hours. Planned maintenance windows normally Sun 02:00–05:00 PT; we will notify 72 hours in advance for scheduled maintenance and 24 hours for minor configuration changes.

- PO & invoicing:
  - Please send POs to billing@optiscale.com with Redwood Inference legal entity and PO number in subject. Sample invoice fields required: PO#, billing contact, remit-to address, tax ID. See attached OptiScale_PO_Instructions.txt for full remit details.

- Security evidence: attaching OptiScale_SOC2_Attestation.pdf. We also provide a data handling matrix on request (can share an access-controlled doc).

- Vendor portal: https://portal.optiscale.com/customer/redwood-inference — we've provisioned a finance role for lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com. If you need admin rights, tell us which account to provision.

Attachments: OptiScale_Support_Playbook_v1.pdf, OptiScale_PO_Instructions.txt, OptiScale_SOC2_Attestation.pdf

Let me know if you want a short call tomorrow to walk through the playbook.

Best,
Leah Park
Head of Partnerships
OptiScale Inc.
leah.park@optiscale.com
+1 (212) 555-0108

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@optiscale.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — support playbook & PO flow (kickoff)

Thanks Leah — quick clarifications from infra/procurement sides:

1) Maintenance windows: are emergency maintenance notifications (unplanned) handled via the same portal + email, and do you guarantee a WARN period for non-emergency maintenance? You mentioned 72h for planned; we need a maximum of 24h notice for minor planned changes that might affect latency.

2) SOC 2: the attestation PDF is great — can you confirm the date of the latest audit and whether it covers the cloud provider (e.g., AWS controls) vs only application-level controls? Our security team will need that detail to complete the vendor risk form.

3) PagerDuty: can you share an escalation phone number for P1s (in addition to PagerDuty token)? Our on-call practice requires an escalation phone number for after-hours cross-org calls.

If you can answer those 3 inline, procurement will proceed to create vendor record and provision finance access.

— Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Ops
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Leah Park <leah.park@optiscale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: billing@optiscale.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — support playbook & PO flow (kickoff)

Hi Karthik — following up with the specifics you asked for:

1) Emergency maintenance: unplanned/emergency maintenance notifications are posted to the portal and emailed to subscribed contacts. For non-emergency planned changes that could impact latency, we commit to a minimum of 24-hour notice for minor config changes and 72 hours for full maintenance windows. Critical security patches may be applied with shorter notice when required; we'll coordinate with your security contact.

2) SOC 2: our latest SOC 2 Type II report is dated 2026-02-10 and covers application controls and vendor management relating to AWS-hosted services; the report includes complementary AWS control mappings in Appendix B. We can provide the SOC 2 report under an NDA or a secure viewer link (preferred).

3) PagerDuty / after-hours call: primary escalation phone number for P1 immediate reach is +1 (857) 555-0244 (OptiScale on-call desk). We'll also send a tokenized PagerDuty link for Redwood's integration.

I'll also add a short bulletin in the portal announcing the provisioning for lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com. If you want admin access instead of finance-only, tell me which user to promote.

Thanks — Leah

Attachments in this message: OptiScale_Support_Playbook_v1.pdf (support runbook), OptiScale_PO_Instructions.txt, OptiScale_SOC2_Attestation.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@optiscale.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, billing@optiscale.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — support playbook & PO flow (kickoff)

Great — thanks for the fast responses and the documents, Leah. Next steps from Redwood procurement: 

- Procurement will create the vendor record by EOD today and provision finance access to the portal for Lauren Bishop.
- Finance will send the initial PO (non-binding) to billing@optiscale.com with attached Redwood_Onboarding_Template.xlsx filled out. Lauren, please confirm when you have access.
- Karthik / Infra will schedule a 30-minute technical onboarding if needed; Karthik prefers Tue 04/14 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 04/15 14:00–15:00 PT.
- Leah, please share the secure viewer link for SOC 2 or send via NDA as you prefer — security will review and we should aim to close the risk form by Fri 04/16.

If all okay, I'll mark the onboarding kickoff as in-progress and loop in our legal if they need to review SLA credit language. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Vanessa
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
